title: Algorithmic Arbitrariness in Content Moderation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmark measurements specifically related to faith or religion. It mentions religion as a protected category under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR) in its theoretical framing of non-discrimination, but the experimental analysis focuses on other demographic groups such as race, LGBTQ, and gender.
findings: This paper does not present any findings related to religion, as its experimental investigation of algorithmic arbitrariness did not include religion as a category of analysis.
